FN-EJP6392-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 280
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/02/2025
Senate Bill 280 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Education Trust Fund to
provide necessary funding to the State Department of Education to support: (1) the creation of a
uniform digital platform to consolidate the required documentation of various educational
programs with the assistance of local boards; (2) the development and implementation
beginning with the 2026-2027 school year, a system of data sharing between the various
educational programs; (3) review and audit all paperwork requirements annually; and (4)
conduct annual audits to ensure local boards of education compliance with the provisions of this
bill.

FN-EJP6392-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 280
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/29/2025
Senate Bill 280 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Education Trust Fund
to provide necessary funding to the State Department of Education to support: (1) the creation of
a uniform digital platform to consolidate the required documentation of various educational
programs with the assistance of local boards; (2) the development and implementation
beginning with the 2026-2027 school year, a system of data sharing between the various
educational programs; (3) review and audit all paperwork requirements annually; and (4)
conduct annual audits to ensure local boards of education compliance with the provisions of this
bill.
Additionally, this bill could increase the obligations of various local boards of education to
reimburse teachers and other education staff for actual expenses incurred when attending
meetings of the Alabama Public Education Paperwork Reduction Committee created by this bill.
